# iboss_allowlist (Data Source)

Reads every entry on a security group's allowlist, in the order the API returns them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iboss_allowlist" "default" {
  group_number = 1
}

output "default_allowlist_urls" {
  value = [for e in data.iboss_allowlist.default.entries : e.url]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_number` (Number) Security (filtering) group number whose allowlist to read. Sent as `currentPolicyBeingEdited`.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Entries on the allowlist. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) The group number.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `apply_keyword_and_safe_search` (Boolean) Keyword and safe search flag (`applyKeywordAndSafeSearch`).
- `direction` (Number) Direction code (`direction`); value meanings are undocumented.
- `do_dlp_scan` (Boolean) DLP scan flag (`doDlpScan`).
- `do_malware_scan` (Boolean) Malware scan flag (`doMalwareScan`).
- `end_port` (Number) End port (`endPort`).
- `global` (Boolean) Global flag (`global`).
- `is_regex` (Boolean) Regular-expression flag (`isRegex`).
- `is_timed_url` (Boolean) Whether the entry expires (`isTimedUrl`).
- `note` (String) Note (`note`).
- `priority` (Number) Priority (`priority`).
- `resource_id` (String) Associated resource ID (`resourceId`).
- `start_port` (Number) Start port (`startPort`).
- `timed_url_expires_in_minutes` (Number) Minutes until a timed entry expires (`timedUrlExpiresInMinutes`).
- `url` (String) URL, domain, or pattern (`url`).
- `weight` (Number) Weight (`weight`).
